notes.title: [Breaking] Brand-New Level 1 Revealed for the First Time!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, Backrooms roommates—it’s been a while![/b][/p][p]Today we’d like to share with you the latest [b]Level 1 design[/b] for [i]Backrooms: The Lost[/i]
(This is the Fandom-version prototype.)[/p][p]All screenshots below are captured from in-game footage—[/p][p][/p][p][b]LEVEL 1: The Open Plaza[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/407cb4b4b1310a9c20322d80d8329469672d5e60.png"][/img][/p][p]Currently, the open plaza is about 50% complete, and we’re still refining details.[/p][p]The design is based on the [i]Backrooms Fandom[/i] Level 1 setting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]LEVEL 1: The Penrose Infinite Staircase[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/a039933229e3b7066acfdfedae284c400c9be965.png"][/img][/p][p]This is one of our [b]original creative twists[/b] in [i]Backrooms: The Lost[/i].[/p][p]Is it going up, or going down? [b]Up or down?[/b][/p][p]Can you tell me?[/p][p][/p][p][b]LEVEL 1: The Decayed Stairwell[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/42aed3c825dc5841f1f27d7ab4a21a8ee60d444d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/dde0ed4f36755d33092893424d8754faeb777835.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to referencing the Fandom version,[/p][p]we aimed for the raw, unfinished look of a concrete shell.[/p][p]For the lighting and atmosphere, we drew inspiration from classic Thai horror films.[/p][p]Can you guess which one?[/p][p][/p][p][b]LEVEL 1: The Bottomless Parking Lot[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/9ab45611adc2eba7674a3b3a66c2fff37917469c.png"][/img][/p][p]Experienced players will notice this immediately—[/p][p]it’s a classic example of [b]liminal space design[/b],[/p][p]a hallmark of the Backrooms aesthetic.[/p][p][/p][p][b]LEVEL 1: The Warehouse Parking Area[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/9ab45611adc2eba7674a3b3a66c2fff37917469c.png"][/img][/p][p]As a typical element of Level 1,[/p][p]we built it with [b]concrete floors + incandescent lamps + a cold, empty vibe[/b].[/p][p]Do you like it?[/p][p][/p][p]That’s our current development progress for now.
We’ll continue to share updates with you, roommates, whenever we have new info.[/p][p]If you like what you see, don’t forget to [b]add \[Backrooms : The Lost] to your wishlist[/b] for support![/p]

notes.title: "Backrooms: The Lost" First Gameplay PV
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="9-JLeMRJm4Y;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]To all wanderers on the edge of reality—[/h3][p]The very first [b]gameplay PV[/b] for [i]Backrooms: The Lost[/i] is finally here!
Yes, we’ve brought those yellow corridors from your nightmares, the flickering lights, and the cavernous warehouse spaces that make your heartbeat race—straight into the game.[/p][p]In this PV, you’ll see:[/p][list][*][p]Empty rooms that feel like they’re watching you back[/p][/*][*][p]A low hum and whispers with no clear direction[/p][/*][*][p]“Exit” signs that lead only deeper into the unknown[/p][/*][*][p]Say HELLO with the entity[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the appetizer—the real descent has only begun.
We want you to feel not only fear in [i]Backrooms:The Lost[/i], but also that stubborn hope of “maybe the next turn will lead out.”
Of course, if you turn the wrong way… no worries. We have plenty of space.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to add wishlist to support us! :)[/p]

notes.title: Major Update and New Puzzles in Backrooms:The Lost
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that Backrooms:The Lost has undergone a significant update to its scenes and gameplay!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/c0516d04206cdf1151413da53ceb83fd87545c43.png[/img]
 This update brings a complete overhaul of the game's environments, from eerie corridors to dilapidated halls, with every detail now more immersive and captivating. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/d70bb2e36520e9dea4ffcd003b1bdf981f2f5aad.png[/img]
Additionally, we've introduced a variety of new puzzle mechanics, such as:

Mysterious arrow guides
Interactive phone clues
Hidden environmental puzzles
These ensure that your exploration of this strange world is both challenging and fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/dbe00351491d53dd6daefb6bae5de13b6216589a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/6cf9cdec39c10fbd92cb8920e95b8e9cdcfe7e46.png[/img]
Please take a look at the latest screenshots we've attached to get a sneak peek of the upgraded atmosphere—dim lighting, damp floors, lonely chairs, and teddy bears—all of which will be part of your future adventures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/c7805106a24327524c7c21a35a898b8dd49685b2.png[/img]

 If you like what you see, please add the game to your Steam wishlist and stay tuned for updates! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/1113553d57bf1d2f141cc2fcaf88acae70ebc937.png[/img]
We will also be releasing a free demo in June or July, so you can experience the mystery and excitement firsthand. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Backrooms: The Lost Shines at 2025 BGM Exhibition, Receives Rave Reviews
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that the Backrooms: The Lost team participated in the highly anticipated 2025 BGM Exhibition! This event provided us with an incredible opportunity to connect with players face-to-face, showcase our game, and listen to your feedback.

At the exhibition, our booth was buzzing with excitement! Countless players flocked to our setup, eager to put on their headsets, sit down at the computers, and dive into the mysterious world of Backrooms: The Lost. As they explored the labyrinthine backrooms and solved puzzles, players experienced the thrilling tension and unique design of the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/fa9bc7203f27f3de91d84099617c9e31ab7cc570.jpg[/img]
Image 1: Players at our booth, fully immersed in the world of Backrooms: Lost Realm!

The feedback we received on-site was incredibly encouraging. Many players praised the game’s atmosphere, level design, and sound effects, describing it as “chilling yet addictive”! At the same time, we also gathered valuable suggestions, such as adding more interactive elements and improving the control experience, which will serve as key references for our future updates.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/09c30642d280dd71867d3754c346b56f19441c88.jpg[/img]
Image 2: The BGM Exhibition was packed, with our booth becoming a focal point for players!

The 2025 BGM Exhibition not only showcased the enthusiasm players have for Backrooms: The Lost but also reinforced our commitment to making the game even better. Moving forward, we will continue to refine the game based on your feedback, delivering richer gameplay and a more immersive experience.

A huge thank you to every player who visited our booth and to all the friends in the Steam community who have been supporting us! If you haven’t yet tried Backrooms: The Lost, we invite you to add it to your Steam wishlist and join us in exploring the unknown depths of the backrooms!

Backrooms: The Lost Development Team

April 6, 2025

notes.title: Backrooms:The Lost——Level 0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]We're thrilled to announce that Level 0 in Backrooms: The Lost has been significantly updated! 
This update brings four all - new scenes, each filled with mystery and danger. 
These scenes aren't just visual upgrades but also a huge challenge to players' psychological resilience. Are you ready to confront these new terrors?[/h3]

In the first scene, you'll enter a corridor stacked with books and boxes.
 Under dim light, the scattered papers seem to whisper secrets of the past. 
The blurred images in the wall frames appear to be watching your every move. 
And what horrors lie behind that slightly open door?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/c3038e08977838996c0be3f5f424cd20b1effac5.jpg[/img]
Next, you'll find yourself in a rubble - filled area packed with "STOP" signs. 
These signs warn you not to proceed, yet you have no other choice. 
Wildflowers growing among the ruins contrast eerily with the decay around them, making you wonder if some unknown force has taken over this place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/96effc6859556628696d4c931f31c5a846fd7443.jpg[/img]
The third scene is a corridor overrun by wildflowers. 
Though the flowers look beautiful, they emit a disturbing aura. "STOP" signs line the corridor densely, as if repeating the same warning over and over. 
What awaits you at the end of this flower - lined corridor?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/451e18d7d86d9c0641c085b593340f91f5d6ca26.jpg[/img]
The last scene is a desolate corridor with just a few doors and dim lights. 
The loneliness can induce hallucinations, making you feel something approaching from the dark corners. You must stay alert as danger could strike at any moment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210542/1606c5e213694f01bfecede7bba37a2d1b4950aa.jpg[/img]

These new Level 0 scenes will bring more challenges and surprises to the game. 
We're excited to see how players handle these new environments and hope these updates deliver a more immersive and thrilling experience. 

[h2]Remember, the Backrooms world is unpredictable, so never let your guard down.[/h2]
